summary: Smith gains a rendering skill library -- Mermaid diagrams, GFM markdown, static maps, and composed HTML reports, all backed by a shared, self-contained page-shell.
details: Mermaid diagram source renders server-side to a static, self-contained SVG -- no client-side mermaid.js ships in the artifact.
GFM markdown (with syntax-highlighted code blocks) renders to self-contained HTML; raw HTML embedded in the markdown source is escaped, not passed through.
A list of (lat, lng) locations renders to a static map image, fetched once at job time and embedded inline as base64 -- never loaded live from Google's servers.

render_html_report composes already-rendered fragments (from any of the above, or from the charts skill) into one responsive page sharing a single neutral page-shell, with an optional single accent color.
A per-job tool-call budget and Strands' own native turns/token ceiling both bound a job independently of its wall-clock timeout, so a thrashing job cannot run away.
limitations: Nothing in Nora's runtime calls Smith yet: the sandbox backend that would dispatch a compute job is not wired into composition/runtime until a later phase, so this ships as capability without a caller.
